q: A chemical makes the thylakoid membrane leaky to H+ but leaves every protein working. Which product of illuminated thylakoids is most affected?
options: O2 release stops completely, while ATP production by ATP synthase carries on as normal
ATP production falls sharply, while electron flow to NADP+ and O2 release can continue
NADPH production stops completely, while ATP production rises to make up for the loss
All three products increase, because protons can now move freely across the membrane
explanation: ATP synthesis needs an intact membrane to hold the proton gradient; a leaky membrane dissipates it (uncoupling – ammonia has this effect). Electron transport from water to NADP+ doesn't depend on the gradient – it often speeds up when uncoupled because there is no back-pressure. So the membrane itself is an essential component of the system.
